status_note: 2D FNO comparison stage, pre-registered BEFORE any FNO comparison run. Design for a fair WNO / FNO comparison at the capacity of the selected WNO (C3: 6 layers x width 32, 28,486,403 trainable real parameters), not a reproduction of an earlier FNO run. config = config of the WNO C3 trial registry (capacity study) without the seed; split, train-only normalization of the manuscript loader, targets, loss, Adam, StepLR + min_lr, batch, epochs, checkpoint rule and test blocking are those of C3. WNO C3 seeds 0 / 1 / 2 are REUSED (never retrained). The C3 3-seed means were known when this registry was written (reported by the author 2026-11-01); the FNO configurations were fixed by the rules in 'trials[].design', not by any FNO result of this stage.

config.source_of_values: manuscript run log 'Configuration:' block (db2, level 1, batch 4, step 100, gamma 0.5, min_lr 1e-5, grad_weight 0, knn_k 6) + script argparse defaults for the values the log does not print (width 128, 6 layers, grid 128x96, grid_range (1,1), lr 1e-3, epochs 500, seed 0); width / layers confirmed by the pcwno.pt state_dict shapes

config_source.note: wno_width / wno_layers / wavelet / wno_level are used ONLY for the C3-identical construction of LPE, FP and head (train_fno2d.build_model); the WNO core built there is discarded before training

fno_core.operator: standard FNO SpectralConv2d: rfft2, two corner blocks [:m1, :m2] and [-m1:, :m2] with complex weights (init scale/(Cin*Cout) * randn), irfft2; + 1x1 Conv2d; Mish between layers; fc0 / fc1 / fc2 as WNO2d
fno_core.latent_grid: the same 128 x 96 VRG nodes in the same radial-shell (ring x angle) tensor order as WNO C3 (PCWNO.forward / grid_xy_hw_from_ref). FNO B2 used the Cartesian order.

split.rule: manuscript script make_split: np.random.default_rng(0) over the cases except 60 and 118, which are forced into test; 96 / 12 / 12
split.source: manuscript run log lines 9-16; identical to splits/2d_orig_rng0_forced60_118.json

checkpoint_policy: pcwno_best.pt = model state_dict at the first epoch with the minimum validation total loss (masked per-case MSE averaged over the 12 validation cases; strict <), exactly the manuscript rule; last_model.pt = weights after epoch 500 (added, weights only); no optimizer state, no resume
test_policy: test cases are overwritten with NaN / mask 0 after loading; no test dataset, loader or evaluation exists in this package
precision_policy: PyTorch defaults (as the manuscript run); flags recorded in run_meta.json

trials.design: depth and width of WNO C3 (6 x 32); Fourier modes 34 x 34 = the modes of the existing PyTorch FNO (B2 / fno_matched / fno_small_matched), unchanged. With these modes one FNO layer has 2*W^2*34*34 complex weights = 8*W^2*17*17 of one WNO layer (db2, level 1, 17 x 17 per sub-band) at ANY width, which is why the total equals C3; modes were not re-tuned to match.
trials.ckpt_bytes_measured_with: torch 2.8.0+cu128, CPU, state_dict after one forward

trials.design: depth 4 and modes 16 x 16 of the manuscript TensorFlow PointFNO core (CFD_model_v5_FNO_orig4.py: width 128, 4 layers, 16 x 16), width reduced to the integer whose total is closest to C3 (82: -2.91 %, 83: -0.54 %, 84: +1.87 %). Only the core size is taken over: no BatchNorm / ELU / sigmoid output (common PyTorch pipeline, Mish as WNO), as fno_tfcore.
trials.ckpt_bytes_measured_with: torch 2.8.0+cu128, CPU, state_dict after one forward

author_reported_3seed_mean.source: author's message 2026-11-01; the C3 seed 1 / 2 run files are not in the local workspace; collect_fno.py recomputes both values from the run directories and reports agreement

wno_reference.policy: read only; never retrained, never overwritten

existing_fno_results_reference_only.name: B2 (fno_cart)
existing_fno_results_reference_only.model: fno_matched_vrgcart: width 128, 6 layers, modes 34 x 34, Cartesian VRG order
existing_fno_results_reference_only.engine: pwno2d engine (code/scripts/train_2d_ext.py), dedicated DataLoader generator, best.pt by val_rmse
existing_fno_results_reference_only.use: reference only; not part of the paired comparison (different engine, selection rule, VRG order, size, single seed)

existing_fno_results_reference_only.name: fno_radial (A1 baseline fno_matched)
existing_fno_results_reference_only.model: width 128, 6 layers, modes 34 x 34, radial-shell VRG order
existing_fno_results_reference_only.use: reference only; files only on the server; same engine / selection caveats as B2

existing_fno_results_reference_only.name: manuscript PointFNO (TensorFlow)
existing_fno_results_reference_only.model: width 128, 4 layers, modes 16 x 16, BatchNorm + ELU, sigmoid output
existing_fno_results_reference_only.use: not comparable (15,000 sampled points, all-data normalization, other split and VRG, batch 1, restarted schedule, other targets and metric; docs/RESULT_REPRODUCIBILITY_AUDIT.md 2.4); not retrained

measurements.parameters: params_trainable_real (complex = 2 real) and param_groups, from the built model (run_meta.json)
measurements.gpu_memory: peak_cuda_mem_mb = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated (val_summary.json) + nvidia-smi memory.used every 5 s
measurements.validation: best_val_loss, best_epoch, per-target case-mean NRMSE of pcwno_best.pt and their mean (mean3), per case

analysis.primary: F1 vs WNO C3 on the 12 validation cases, seeds 0 / 1 / 2 (same seed = same LPE / FP / head initial values and the same global RNG stream, i.e. the same shuffle order, as long as both runs draw the same numbers per step). Per arm: mean and sample std (ddof 1) over the 3 seeds of best validation loss, mean3 NRMSE and each target. Paired: FNO - WNO per seed (3 differences, no test of significance with n = 3) and per validation case on seed-mean values (12 pairs: mean difference, 95 % t interval, exact sign-flip permutation p over 2^12, case counts).
analysis.secondary: F2 vs C3 and F2 vs F1 in the same format; reported in full whether run or not ('not run' if the author does not submit it).
analysis.decision_language: no superiority or equivalence claim from 3 seeds and 12 validation cases; differences whose interval includes 0 are reported as 'no detectable difference'; the result is reported whichever arm is lower
analysis.test: never: test cases blocked in every run; no test evaluation in this stage
